response.sql: WITH race_avg AS (SELECT ds.raceId, AVG(ds.wins) AS rw FROM driverStandings ds GROUP BY ds.raceId), country_avg AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(ra.rw) AS avg_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId JOIN race_avg ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY c.country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS o FROM country_avg), above AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins FROM country_avg ca, overall WHERE ca.avg_wins > overall.o), grp AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS g FROM above) SELECT a.country, a.avg_wins, a.avg_wins - overall.o AS above_overall_avg, a.avg_wins - grp.g AS above_group_avg FROM above a, overall, grp WHERE a.avg_wins > grp.g ORDER BY a.avg_wins DESC
